text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Takamatsunomiya Kinen. The 
stands overflowed with passionate fans of 
Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer worries that it might be 
putting too much pressure on her. Fuji 
Kiseki puts on a smile, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She accidentally knocked over a cup. 
Noticing such an uncharacteristic mistake, 
the Trainer felt a slight sense of 
unease...
